volunteerExperiences.description:
• Raised money through fundraisers to donate books to children
• Introduced a nonprofit organization "Ohana 100" to club members
• Read books to children every week and documented 70+ club members' volunteering hours

• Founded an organization to read books to children using online platforms during COVID-19
• Recorded 100+ videos for children to watch for free
• Introduced it to school JROTC and served as a Service Learning Organizer

organizations.name: Asian American Student Association at Vanderbilt
organizations.description:
• Led the Asian American Student Association, organizing annual events for APIDAM, such as AASA Night Market, Fables and Florals, and Taste of Asia, which attracted over 300 attendees and fostered a strong sense of community and cultural pride
• Secured funding through grants and co-sponsorships, collaborating with local and school Asian groups to support and enhance club activities

organizations.name: Rothschild Residential College at Vanderbilt University
organizations.description:
• Led a team of 4+ members to manage a residential college of 800+ students, organizing events to boost community engagement and improve student life
• Planned and executed major events like College Cups to increase student participation by 50% and enhance college spirit
